title: The Frost Shrine
text: A shrine of ice to a winter god, its altar glittering blue. Offerings lie frozen into it layer on layer: coins, a sword, a lock of hair, a child's doll with its arms held out. There is frost on the doll's lashes.

options.label: Leave an offering of your own, and ask the winter god for mercy.

outcomes.text: The coin freezes into the altar. For a day the wind drops.

options.label: The strongest pries the sword from the ice, offering or not.

outcomes.text: The steel is cold. It never dulls, and it never warms.
The god takes something back in ice from the hand that took the sword.

options.label: The devout prays to the winter god, hoping it hears a stranger.

outcomes.text: The winter god listens. The cold becomes a kind of strength that settles in the bones.
